clue.text: Quits, as it were — really meaning it?

definitions.meaning: getting even through revenge, which makes two people quits
doing something with great force and intensity

explanation.walkthrough: The first sense is read playfully: taking a vengeance is how you end up quits with someone.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means forcefully or to an extreme degree, so it fits doing something in earnest.

clue.text: Inclines to dismiss a visual aid

indicators.note: to dismiss means to send away, so the letter given by the word a is sent out of the synonym

parts.note: inclines means leans

explanation.surface: Someone tilts their head and gets rid of their glasses.
explanation.definitionFit: A piece of curved glass in spectacles or a camera is a classic aid to seeing.

clue.text: Long arrangement of rope? Not hard

indicators.note: not here tells us to leave out the letter for hard from the rope word

parts.note: a hitch is a knot, an arrangement of rope
H is the pencil abbreviation for hard

explanation.surface: A puzzled question about some lengthy rope arrangement that is not difficult.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Long' looks like an adjective describing the rope, but it is the verb meaning to yearn, the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: To long for something is to yearn for it, and to itch to do something is the same eager desire.

clue.text: Repeat: 'I support imprisoning renegade'

indicators.note: imprisoning means holding inside, so the support word locks up the renegade word

parts.note: a tee supports a golf ball
a rat is a deserter or turncoat

explanation.surface: A quoted pledge of backing for jailing a traitor, offered as something to say again.
explanation.definitionFit: To iterate is to say or do again, a synonym of repeat as a verb.

clue.text: One with job on line receiving hard address

parts.note: A is one, the indefinite article
a post is a job

indicators.note: receiving means taking in, so the line word takes the letter for hard inside it

parts.note: a rope is a line
H is the pencil abbreviation for hard

explanation.surface: A worker on a production line is given a stern talking-to.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on' simply places the line pieces after the job pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: In rhetoric this is a speech turning aside to address an absent person directly, so it is a form of address.

clue.text: Part of chain restraining one, angry? Not initially a good idea

indicators.note: restraining means holding in, so the shop outlet word holds the letter for one

parts.note: a branch is one outlet of a chain of shops
I is the Roman numeral one

indicators.note: not initially means without its first letter, so the opening of the synonym for angry is lost

parts.note: wild means furious, angry

explanation.surface: A link of chain holding something back, with a question of temper.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone's pet invention or original notion is called their own creation of the mind, a good idea of theirs.

clue.text: Detained party, I fancy, may appear here

definitions.text: Detained party, I fancy, may appear here

indicators.note: fancy as a verb means imagine, and as an adjective means elaborate, either way signalling a rearrangement of the words before it

explanation.surface: A guess that someone in custody might be shown in a police line-up.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue is both the wordplay and the definition: a suspect held by police may be put in a line-up.
explanation.definitionFit: Police line up a suspect among others for a witness to pick out, so a detained person appears there.

clue.text: See our debacle in dissolution — about time for this?

definitions.text: See our debacle in dissolution — about time for this?

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the rearranged letters go round the letter for time
in dissolution means broken up, so the letters of the phrase before it fall apart and re-form

explanation.surface: A couple, seeing their marriage fail, wonder whether the final court order is due.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue is also the definition: a marriage's dissolution ends with this order, and 'in dissolution' doubles as the anagram signal.
explanation.definitionFit: This is the final court order that ends a marriage in English divorce law.

clue.text: Something added about house — something added about house sport — identifies contributor to match

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the postscript letters go round the house abbreviation

parts.note: PS, a postscript, is something added to a letter

indicators.note: about again means surrounding, so the second postscript goes round house and sport together

parts.note: PS again, a postscript
HO again is the abbreviation for house
RU stands for Rugby Union, a sport

explanation.surface: A rambling, repetitive description that ends by pointing to what goes into a match.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is 'contributor to match'; 'identifies' is the link word joining wordplay to definition.
explanation.definitionFit: The element is used on match heads to make them ignite, so it contributes to a match.

clue.text: Relieved expression, avoiding hot seat

indicators.note: avoiding means keeping away from, so the letter for hot is left out of the exclamation

parts.note: phew is what you say when relieved
H is the abbreviation for hot, as on taps

explanation.surface: A sigh of relief at escaping an uncomfortable chair.
explanation.definitionFit: A long bench in a church is a kind of seat.

clue.text: One from South America and one North, going to Central America

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one
CA is the abbreviation for Central America

explanation.surface: A traveller from the south heads north to Central America.
explanation.definitionFit: The Incas were a people of the Andes, so a member of them is one from South America.

clue.text: Metal point not finished

indicators.note: not finished means missing its end, so the last letter of the synonym is dropped

parts.note: a tine is a point or prong of a fork or antler

explanation.surface: A metal tip that has not been polished off.
explanation.definitionFit: Sn on the periodic table is a soft silvery metal.

clue.text: Drug carried by town river with treatment to get through cold period

indicators.note: carried by means held within, so the drug letter sits inside the other letters
treatment means processing, so the letters of the two words beside it are worked into a new order

parts.note: E is the abbreviation for the drug ecstasy

explanation.surface: Drugs smuggled by a river town, with medical care to survive winter.
explanation.definitionFit: To spend the winter somewhere, surviving until spring, is to get through the cold season.

clue.text: Scrap with fashionable fool about British film

parts.note: a rag is a scrap of cloth
in means fashionable

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the fool word goes round the letter for British

parts.note: to gull is to fool, and a gull is a dupe

explanation.surface: A trendy idiot gets into a fight over a British movie.
explanation.definitionFit: Martin Scorsese's 1980 boxing picture starring Robert De Niro is a famous film.

clue.text: Invoicing without first including pound charge leads to resentment

indicators.note: including means taking in, so the shortened word holds the charge and pound letters
without first means losing the opening letter of the invoicing synonym

parts.note: billing means invoicing
a fee is a charge
L is the abbreviation for a pound, from libra

explanation.surface: Sending bills, then adding a charge of a pound, breeds resentment.
explanation.walkthrough: 'leads to' is a link joining wordplay to definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Bad blood or hostility between people is the same thing as resentment.

clue.text: Contralto mostly abandoned indication on score

indicators.note: mostly means all but the end, so the synonym for abandoned loses its final letter

parts.note: left means abandoned

explanation.surface: A singer is mostly dropped, according to the marking on the sheet music.
explanation.definitionFit: The sign at the start of a stave showing pitch is a marking on a musical score.

clue.text: Look for comfort — recoil of weapon's broken leg

indicators.note: recoil means spring back, so the weapon word runs the other way

parts.note: weapon's read as guns, plural

indicators.note: broken means smashed, so the letters of leg are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone seeks comfort after a gun's kickback has broken their leg.
explanation.definitionFit: To cuddle up close is to seek warmth and comfort from someone.

clue.text: Best friend consuming a lot of time in pursuit of love

indicators.note: in pursuit of means following, so the friend pieces come after the letter for love

parts.note: O is love, a zero score in tennis

indicators.note: consuming means eating up, so the friend word swallows the shortened time word

parts.note: a pal is a friend

indicators.note: a lot of means most but not all, so the time word loses its last letter

parts.note: time taken as written

explanation.surface: A best friend uses up most of their time chasing romance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Best friend' looks like one phrase, but 'Best' alone is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Ideal or most favourable is what the best possible outcome is.

clue.text: Cheers up, insulated by knowing to ignore a piece of legislation

indicators.note: insulated by means wrapped inside, so the turned thanks word goes in the shortened knowing word
to ignore means to leave out, so the letter given by a is dropped

parts.note: astute means knowing, shrewd

indicators.note: up in a down clue means reading upwards, so the thanks word is turned round

parts.note: ta is British slang for thanks, like cheers

explanation.surface: Raising thanks, wrapped in sharp awareness, while overlooking a law.
explanation.definitionFit: A written law passed by a legislature is a piece of legislation.

clue.text: Poor farmer — ready for business, but nothing's shifting

indicators.note: shifting means moving, so the round letter changes place within the word

parts.note: open means ready for business, as a shop
O is nothing, zero

explanation.surface: A struggling farmer has his stall open, but none of the goods are selling.
explanation.definitionFit: A peasant labourer in Latin America is a poor farm worker.

clue.text: Platter? Her diet's wrecked after short space

indicators.note: after means coming later, so the rearranged letters follow the space unit

parts.note: an en is a printer's space, shorter than an em

indicators.note: wrecked means ruined, so the letters of the words before it are rearranged

explanation.surface: A plate of food ruins a woman's diet.
explanation.definitionFit: A dish for serving the course before the main one is a kind of platter.

clue.text: Detective seeing nothing different when turning up?

definitions.note: a private ... is slang for a private detective, and the word reads the same either way

indicators.text: seeing nothing different when turning up?
indicators.note: in a down light, read upwards, the word looks the same, so it reads identically both ways

parts.note: a private ... is slang for a private detective, and the word reads the same either way

explanation.surface: A detective who sees nothing new when he shows up.
explanation.walkthrough: 'seeing' hints at the answer's own sense of sight; 'turning up' means read bottom to top in a down entry.
explanation.definitionFit: A private eye is an American slang term for a private detective.

clue.text: Briefly near abandoning literary style? I am surprised

indicators.note: abandoning means giving up, so the abbreviated near letters are taken out

parts.note: a genre is a literary style or category
NR is the abbreviation for near

explanation.surface: Someone is startled to see a writer give up their style.
explanation.definitionFit: The interjection expresses mild surprise, like saying 'well I never'.

clue.text: Pointedly ignore note included in membership renewal?

indicators.note: included in means placed inside, so the note letter goes in the fee word

parts.note: a sub, a subscription, is paid to renew membership

explanation.surface: Someone is cold-shouldered by a note slipped into their club renewal.
explanation.definitionFit: To rebuff or cold-shoulder someone deliberately is to ignore them pointedly.

clue.text: Shed light on state in which one finds boy and girl in Dickens

parts.note: lit means shed light on, illuminated

indicators.note: in which one finds means containing, so the boy's name sits within the state word

parts.note: to tell is to state
Len is a boy's name

explanation.surface: Illuminating a situation where a boy and a girl appear in a Dickens novel.
explanation.walkthrough: 'boy and girl' looks like one pair; only 'boy' is wordplay, and 'girl in Dickens' is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: The child heroine of The Old Curiosity Shop is the famous Dickens girl Nell Trent.

clue.text: No initiation of flash connection

indicators.note: no initiation of means without the start, so the first letter of the flash word goes

parts.note: a blink is a flash, an instant

explanation.surface: A flash fails to start, so the connection is lost.
explanation.definitionFit: A tie or bond joining two things is a connection.

clue.text: Shelter not getting approval?

parts.note: no means not
OK signals approval

explanation.surface: A refuge that fails to get the go-ahead.
explanation.definitionFit: A snug sheltered corner or recess is a place to shelter.

clue.text: Pouring in addition will involve new rainwear

parts.note: welling means pouring out, as water

indicators.note: involve means take in, so the in-addition phrase wraps round the letter for new

parts.note: to boot means in addition

explanation.surface: Pouring rain will mean wearing fresh waterproofs.
explanation.definitionFit: A rubber knee boot worn in wet weather is footwear for the rain, an item of rainwear.
